description: Unofficial fan-art animated companion inspired by Clank from Ratchet & Clank. Features chest-button self-checks, antenna and head scans, a compact propeller greeting, wrist-tool maintenance, hinged mechanical jumps and three alternating-foot running views. Simplified panel lines, check button and tool choreography are original creative adaptations. Independently drawn; not endorsed by the rights holder.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
